## **Welcome**

Hello! I am a Postdoctoral Research Fellow at the São Paulo School of Business Administration (FGV EAESP), supported by a fellowship from the São Paulo Research Foundation (FAPESP). I hold a PhD in Economics from the São Paulo School of Economics (FGV EESP). My research focuses on empirical asset pricing and behavioral finance, with a particular emphasis on retail investors. Prior to my PhD, I earned a Master's degree in Economics from FGV EESP and a Bachelor's degree in Economics from the University of São Paulo at Ribeirão Preto (FEA-RP/USP).

**Awards**

-   Best Paper in Finance Award - SBE (2024)
-   Runner-Up FGC Prize in EBFIN (2024)
-   FAPESP Pos-Doc Position Fellowship (2026-2029)
-   FAPESP Doc Fellowship (2024-2026)
-   CAPES Fellowship (2020-2024)
